display.purpose: Page headings. One per view, always in the header. Serif texture is the brand signal.

headline.purpose: Card titles, section headings within pages. Carries authority without display scale.

body.purpose: All readable text. Inter's OpenType alternates are active for optimized letterforms.

label.purpose: Section labels, field labels, metadata categories. Wide tracking and uppercase are the hierarchy signal.

mono.purpose: Model names, DOIs, search term chips, note editing. Gives data a distinct texture.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Separates the drawer overlay from the blurred scrim. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-color
motion.purpose: Standard transition for all interactive state changes.

motion.name: ease-opacity
motion.purpose: Fade for action buttons on group-hover, save-state indicators.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Use Button with variant=primary for the main action in a visible task group.
components.css: .litera-btn-primary { min-height: var(--litera-control-sm); padding: var(--litera-space-1) var(--litera-space-3); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-md); background-color: var(--litera-accent); color: var(--litera-accent-contrast); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Use the default Button for a secondary action and ghost for a low-emphasis toolbar action.
components.css: .litera-btn { min-height: var(--litera-control-sm); padding: var(--litera-space-1) var(--litera-space-3); border: 1px solid var(--litera-border); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-md); background-color: var(--litera-paper); color: var(--litera-text); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Use Input with a visible label. A placeholder can show an example value.
components.css: .litera-input { border: 1px solid var(--litera-border); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-md); background-color: var(--litera-bg); color: var(--litera-text); padding: var(--litera-space-1) var(--litera-space-3); }

components.name: Card Panel
components.description: Group related fields and their associated action. Use a flat list for repeated records.
components.css: .litera-panel { border: 1px solid var(--litera-border); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-lg); background-color: var(--litera-surface-1); } .p-4 { padding: var(--litera-space-4); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Use links between routes and aria-current for the current page.
components.html: LibraryImport
components.css: .litera-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: var(--litera-control-md); padding-inline: var(--litera-space-2); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-md); color: var(--litera-mute); } .litera-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background-color: var(--litera-selected); color: var(--litera-text); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Use for secondary group headings. Associate each form control with its own label.

components.name: Page Header
components.description: Use PageHeader for the title and page-wide actions. Put list filters and sorting in PageToolbar.
components.css: .litera-page-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--litera-space-3); padding: var(--litera-space-3) var(--litera-page-inset); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--litera-border); } .litera-page-title { color: var(--litera-text); font-size: 1.3125rem; font-weight: 640; line-height: 1.25; }

components.name: Search Term Chip
components.description: Monospace chip for search terms and keywords. Distinct from metadata chips by typeface.
components.css: .ds-chip-term { font-family: var(--litera-font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--litera-text); padding: var(--litera-space-1) var(--litera-space-2); border-radius: var(--litera-radius-sm); border: 1px solid var(--litera-border); background-color: var(--litera-hover); }

narrative.overview: LitFolio is a research desk for finding, organizing and reading papers. src/styles/palette.css defines the three palettes and their day and night roles. CoreFrame passes the active colors to the library and reader.
keyCharacteristics: Keep papers, metadata and notes visually ahead of navigation and controls.
Use the current theme's semantic surfaces, text, accent and status colors.
Use a 4 px space scale and derive nested corners from the parent inset.
Keep titles, field labels, errors and the actions needed to proceed visible.

rules.name: Color roles
rules.body: Use --litera-sidebar for app navigation, --litera-subnav for section navigation, --litera-bg for the workspace and --litera-paper for reading surfaces. Pair --litera-accent with --litera-accent-contrast for the main action and --litera-annotation-bg with --litera-annotation-ink for highlights. Use the selected surface and a shape cue for the current item.

rules.name: Spacing and corners
rules.body: Use 4 px for tight repeats, 8 px between related controls, 12 px between subgroups, 16 px inside panels and 24 px between page regions. Use equal padding on all sides where children share one boundary. For concentric corners subtract the inset from the outer radius. A 12 px tab list radius with a 4 px inset yields an 8 px tab radius.

rules.name: Touch targets
rules.body: On narrow screens or with a coarse pointer, give navigation items, action buttons and disclosures independent hit areas of at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels using --litera-target-touch. Keep icons at their normal size and allow labels to wrap.

rules.name: Interaction semantics
rules.body: Use Radix Tabs for sections, Dropdown Menu radio items for immediate sorting, Select for a form value and Radio Group for visible mutually exclusive options. Use DetailDrawer for a focused inspection task that needs explicit dismissal and focus restoration.

rules.name: Help and feedback
rules.body: Keep labels, values, constraints and destructive consequences visible. Use a tooltip for a short control hint, a disclosure for optional instructions and an alert for a condition requiring attention.

dos: Emphasize Import in the DOI form. Use secondary or ghost buttons for accompanying actions.
Use menu radio items for RSS sorting. The menu exposes the selected option and supports arrow keys, Enter and Escape.
Give a compact action such as Refresh an accessible name and a tooltip.
Use DetailDrawer for article details so the user can return to the same article list.
Give an empty state an action when the user can add content or clear a filter.
Keep model setting labels visible and put API compatibility help in a disclosure.
donts: Give every action, tab or repeated row its own filled accent surface.
Implement sorting as a group of pressed buttons with custom keyboard logic.
Use tooltip text as the only accessible name or hide blocking errors in a tooltip.
Present a short list as a stack of elevated cards or reserve blank rows for absent metadata.
Set a local hex color, 10 px gutter or 6 px radius where a shared token applies.
Repeat a title, field label or visible action in a permanent explanatory paragraph.
